name: segment-affinity
beat: Targeting: a bid reaches related segments at a discount, never overcharged
description: Café Patio bids on Coffee and Fast Food only. A donut tags Pastry/Doughnuts, which the catalog pairs with Coffee (0.4): Patio bids at 2 CLP/AS, which can't clear the reserve on its own, so the house ad plays and nobody pays. Add a cup and the exact Coffee viewer wins it, with the donut eater counted as a partial reach. A soda next to a sandwich reaches Fast Food the same way. Alcohol never widens its reach, and a bicycle (nobody bids on the sports family) stays a house ad.

steps.note: related only: a weak, cheap match that can't buy the screen alone
exact + related on one bid: each segment counted once, at its own weight
a soft drink reaches the Fast Food bid through the curated combo pair
alcohol reaches its own segment only; the oracle fails any widened match
a segment no campaign reaches, exactly or by affinity: house ad, nobody bids
minor_likely blocks only restricted categories; the coffee basket still plays
